headline: Keeper, DPA and U87 paired by the waveform itself — and named after the keeper.
highlights: Three drop boxes — Keeper, DPA, U87.
Apply _DPA / _U87 Names renames every matched raw file in place to its keeper's name plus the mic suffix.
Collect into Folders copies or moves the session's files into KEEPER, DPA and U87 folders inside a destination you choose.
